No hay unidades entregadas pendientes de: There are no delivered units left to refund in this order. Settle it with the store and mark it as reviewed.
NEXOVAX encontró las unidades que suman: NEXOVAX found the units that add up exactly to the refund; check the selection.
Ninguna combinación de unidades suma exa: No combination of units adds up exactly to the refund (price + tax per unit). If it was a free-form discount, mark it as reviewed and settle it with the store.
Se registra como reembolso sin devolució: It’s recorded as a refund without return with the processor’s reference: no money is refunded again, the amount is deducted from the store’s earnings and the commission is reversed.
Es un reembolso parcial o el pedido ya a: It’s a partial refund or the order has already moved on. Record it against the units it covered to deduct it from the store; if it was a free-form discount, settle it with the store and mark it as reviewed.
Política de disputas actualizada. Aplica: Dispute policy updated. It applies to orders paid from now on.
Quién asume el dinero cuando el cliente: Who bears the money when the customer wins a dispute or chargeback.
El dinero que el banco o PayPal devuelve: The money the bank or PayPal returns to the customer. If the store pays it, it’s deducted from its balance and the commission is reversed.
El cargo fijo que cobra Stripe o PayPal: The fixed fee Stripe or PayPal charges per dispute (e.g. US$ 15).
El cambio aplica a los pedidos pagados d: The change applies to orders paid from now on. Earlier orders keep the policy they were sold under.
Hay {n} disputas abiertas: se resolverán: There are {n} open disputes: they’ll be resolved under their original policy.
¿Cancelar la versión programada? No entr: Cancel the scheduled version? It won’t take effect.
Se publicará sola en esa fecha; hasta en: It will publish itself on that date; until then the current version stays in force.
Queda programada: el {d} reemplaza a la: It’s scheduled: on {d} it replaces the current version and is shown in the help center.
Los productos destacados se muestran en: Featured products are shown in this order. Use the arrows and save.
Si dejas una traducción vacía, se usa la: If you leave a translation empty, the automatic translation (when the text is the original one) or the English text is used.
